note: Tool-pick golden set. `why` is not scored and is the most valuable column in the file: it is how a person reading a failure six weeks from now can tell whether the model was wrong or the row was.

rows.request: who runs the agent at http://localhost:8001?
rows.why: asks about identity of an agent at a URL, no work requested

rows.request: what skills does that peer actually offer?
rows.why: capability discovery, which is what the card is for

rows.request: can we even talk to the agent on 8001?
rows.why: reachability and binding compatibility, still discovery

rows.request: payments-api is throwing 500s for about a third of requests
rows.why: an incident description, no explicit instruction, still triage work

rows.request: please restart the payments service, it is wedged again
rows.why: an action request; the peer decides whether it needs a human

rows.request: the checkout queue has been backing up since 09:40
rows.why: an outage narrative with a timestamp

rows.request: where is the runbook for restarting payments-api?
rows.why: a knowledge request the peer handles; tests that we do not over-narrow to actions

rows.request: approve task tk_8f21, I am u_772
rows.why: names a task id and a decision

rows.request: reject that one, we are not restarting anything during the freeze
rows.why: a decision on a pending task, phrased without an id

rows.request: go ahead with the restart you proposed
rows.why: approval phrased as agreement; the hardest row in the set

rows.request: what is the capital of France?
rows.why: no tool should fire; a set without this optimises into a server that answers everything

rows.request: summarise the last three messages in this conversation
rows.why: the host can do this; reaching for a tool here is a false positive
